jobs.description:
**Build Your Career with Ashley**

**Field Manager of Licensee Sales**

**What Will You Do?**

* Conduct ongoing location visits to identify and support the licensee in product training, merchandising and product assortments, partner on velocity walks and help support any additional areas of opportunity to help grow wholesale sales.
* Supports licensee new store openings and grand re-openings. Participates in new licensee onboarding.
* Participates in operational strategy meetings to devise execute best practices or improvement plans to address region licensee needs or correct identified issues.
* Ensures licensees in district remain in compliance with the TUA. Monitors brand standards, including product and visual, through a rigorous protocol of field visits and licensee self-reporting to help improve and continually enhance brand equity in the licensee community.
* Fosters the licensee network communication process, including field reports, weekly newsletters, quarterly business strategy meetings and reporting protocols. Maintains strong relationships with the region licensees. Resolves licensee issues and concerns.
* Attends Markets to help introduce licensees to new products and programs.
* Participates in quarterly Licensee Sales meetings to provide team building and support to licensees.
* Assists in the support of Tier 2-5 licensees as needed. Works as part of a team, plus on occasion will engage in deeper dives into problematic areas or developing opportunities as a member of a “strike force” approach.
* Promotes the Ashley brand image through active involvement in community associations and events, such as the Chamber of Commerce, Kiwanis, or Rotary Club or volunteer organizations.
* Demonstrates the company’s core and growth values in performance of all job functions.

**What Do You Need?**

* Bachelor’s degree required in Business Administration, Management, Marketing or related field or an equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered.
* Three to five years of retail sales and sales management or distribution center experience. Preferably with experience in furniture retail and fulfillment-based operations employing a license or franchise model.
* Visual Merchandising, Furniture or Training experience a plus.
* Exceptional knowledge of retail, sales and training operations processes.
* Willingness to travel 80%
* Ability to facilitate training and/ or presentations in front of small and large audiences.
* Strong business acumen, with demonstrated knowledge of finance, management, marketing and merchandising.
* Knowledge of licensed business owner or franchise law.
* Knowledge of training management and improvement methods and tools.
* Outstanding analytical and problem solving skills, with the ability to dig deep into the data and then turning that insight into action to drive results.
* Outstanding leadership skills, with the ability to build an inspiring culture through vision, empowerment and development.
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to organize thoughts, communicate clearly, completely and concisely.
* Strong project/resource management and organizational skills, with the ability to consistently meet demanding deadlines.
* Strong skills in relationship management and coaching that result in the accomplishment of goals.
* Strong skills in agility, along with the ability to pivot easily when directions and priorities change on short notice.
* Strong skills in MS Office Suite or similar office software.

**Who Are We?**

At Ashley, we’re more than a business…we’re family. As the largest manufacturer of home furnishings in the world, we know what it takes to build incredible furniture and future leaders. We’re problem solvers with the grit to persevere during challenging times and innovators who won't coast when times are good. We create solutions, not excuses. And never settle for status quo. It’s the reason we’re always searching for better ways to delivering an exceptional customer experience. That's why Ashley Furniture is #1 in our industry.

Ready to grow? You’ve come to the right place. Ashley Furniture has a “Growth Mindset”, and once you join our team, you’ll learn from the best in the business.

Apply today and find your home at Ashley!

**Benefits We Offer**

* Health, Dental, Vision, Employee Assistance Program
* Paid Vacation (80 Hours), Holidays, and Your Birthday off
* Generous Employee Discount on home furnishings
* Professional Development Opportunities
* Ashley Wellness Centers (location specific) and Medical Tourism
* Telehealth
* 401(k) and Profit Sharing
* Life Insurance

**Our Core Values**

* Honesty & Integrity
* Passion, Drive, Discipline
* Continuous Improvement/Operational Excellence
* Dirty Fingernail
* Growth Focused

To learn more about Ashley Furniture, our community engagement programs, environmental stewardship, and our core values, please visit our Corporate Social Responsibility information page:

https://www.ashleyfurniture.com/about-us/corporate-social-responsibility/report/

*We are an equal opportunity employer and provide a drug-free working environment. While Ashley appreciates the interest of all candidates only those meeting specific position requirements may be contacted. Principals Only.*

jobs.description:
The Marketing Coordinator works directly with marketing management to drive brand awareness and intent to visit Ashley HomeStores. The Marketing Coordinator is responsible for providing **Storis** operational support and general assistance to the marketing department in the day-to-day management of marketing initiatives. This position works closely with internal stakeholders across multiple disciplines and outside agencies to ensure communications and promotions are aligned with marketing objectives. The Marketing Coordinator is accountable for the continued growth of awareness, engagement and visitation by implementing strategies of marketing initiatives.

**Primary Job Functions:**

1. Storis expert for the marketing team that serves as liaison for all departments.

2. Facilitate the creative process, including submitting work requests, reviewing changes and routing for

approval.

3. Work closely with various departments to ensure marketing campaigns are deployed as planned.

4. Provide project management for all assigned projects, ensuring deadlines are met and projects progress

in a timely fashion.

5. Pull campaign results, update reporting and assist with campaign analysis.

6. Contribute to brainstorming, consistently monitoring competitive landscape and marketing trends in

order to make effective recommendations.

7. Communicate effectively with other members of the marketing team to meet department goals.

8. Establish and maintain effective communication and working relations with internal and external

partners in order to secure and maintain their cooperation for assistance with special events and

promotional programs.

9. Coordinate the creation and printing of all internal marketing material requests.

10. Provide administrative support for the marketing department; schedule meetings, order and maintain

office supplies, coordinate events, book travel, submit expense reports, etc.

11. Demonstrate the Company’s Core and Growth Values in the performance of all job functions

**Secondary Job Functions:**

1. May be responsible for store assistance and support when necessary for events such as grand openings or other special events.

2. Maintain reliable attendance.

3. Actively participate in departmental meetings, training and education. Assist with training other employees and providing backup.

4. Complete other assignments and special projects as requested.

**Education:**

Bachelor degree in Marketing, Communications, Advertising or related field, or equivalent work experience, Required

**Experience:**

1 year experience in Marketing, Required

**Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:**

• Storis

• Knowledge of standard concepts, practice and procedures associated with

online and offline marketing efforts

• Knowledge of branding, marketing and advertising principles

• Flawless execution and excellent attention to detail

• Project management and presentation skills

• Effectively work in a cross-functional team environment

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills

• Excellent interpersonal skills

• Effective time management and organizational skills

• Work independently as well as in a team environment

• Document management system

• Analytical and problem solving skills

• Maintain confidentiality

• Working knowledge of Continuous Improvement

• Handle multiple projects simultaneously within established time constraints

• Proficient computer skills, including experience with Microsoft Office Suite, internet

• Strong skills in agility, along with the ability to pivot easily when directions and

priorities changes on short notice

• Perform under strong demands in a fast-paced environment

• Work professionally with customers and co-workers to efficiently serve our

customers, treating both with enthusiasm and respect

• Display empathy, understanding and patience with employees and external customers

• Respond professionally in situations with difficult employee/vendor/customer issues or inquiries

**Schedule Expectations:**

1. Occasional Domestic Travel

2. Flexible and willing to work extended hours when necessary.

**Job Competencies:**

1. Ethics and values

2. Integrity and trust

jobs.description:
**Build Your Career with Ashley**

**Field Manager of Licensee Sales**

**What Will You Do?**

* Conduct ongoing location visits to identify and support the licensee in product training, merchandising and product assortments, partner on velocity walks and help support any additional areas of opportunity to help grow wholesale sales.
* Supports licensee new store openings and grand re-openings. Participates in new licensee onboarding.
* Participates in operational strategy meetings to devise execute best practices or improvement plans to address region licensee needs or correct identified issues.
* Ensures licensees in district remain in compliance with the TUA. Monitors brand standards, including product and visual, through a rigorous protocol of field visits and licensee self-reporting to help improve and continually enhance brand equity in the licensee community.
* Fosters the licensee network communication process, including field reports, weekly newsletters, quarterly business strategy meetings and reporting protocols. Maintains strong relationships with the region licensees. Resolves licensee issues and concerns.
* Attends Markets to help introduce licensees to new products and programs.
* Participates in quarterly Licensee Sales meetings to provide team building and support to licensees.
* Assists in the support of Tier 2-5 licensees as needed. Works as part of a team, plus on occasion will engage in deeper dives into problematic areas or developing opportunities as a member of a “strike force” approach.
* Promotes the Ashley brand image through active involvement in community associations and events, such as the Chamber of Commerce, Kiwanis, or Rotary Club or volunteer organizations.
* Demonstrates the company’s core and growth values in performance of all job functions.

**What Do You Need?**

* Bachelor’s degree required in Business Administration, Management, Marketing or related field or an equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered.
* Three to five years of retail sales and sales management or distribution center experience. Preferably with experience in furniture retail and fulfillment-based operations employing a license or franchise model.
* Visual Merchandising, Furniture or Training experience a plus.
* Exceptional knowledge of retail, sales and training operations processes.
* Willingness to travel 80%
* Ability to facilitate training and/ or presentations in front of small and large audiences.
* Strong business acumen, with demonstrated knowledge of finance, management, marketing and merchandising.
* Knowledge of licensed business owner or franchise law.
* Knowledge of training management and improvement methods and tools.
* Outstanding analytical and problem solving skills, with the ability to dig deep into the data and then turning that insight into action to drive results.
* Outstanding leadership skills, with the ability to build an inspiring culture through vision, empowerment and development.
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to organize thoughts, communicate clearly, completely and concisely.
* Strong project/resource management and organizational skills, with the ability to consistently meet demanding deadlines.
* Strong skills in relationship management and coaching that result in the accomplishment of goals.
* Strong skills in agility, along with the ability to pivot easily when directions and priorities change on short notice.
* Strong skills in MS Office Suite or similar office software.

**Who Are We?**

At Ashley, we’re more than a business…we’re family. As the largest manufacturer of home furnishings in the world, we know what it takes to build incredible furniture and future leaders. We’re problem solvers with the grit to persevere during challenging times and innovators who won't coast when times are good. We create solutions, not excuses. And never settle for status quo. It’s the reason we’re always searching for better ways to delivering an exceptional customer experience. That's why Ashley Furniture is #1 in our industry.

Ready to grow? You’ve come to the right place. Ashley Furniture has a “Growth Mindset”, and once you join our team, you’ll learn from the best in the business.

Apply today and find your home at Ashley!

**Benefits We Offer**

* Health, Dental, Vision, Employee Assistance Program
* Paid Vacation (80 Hours), Holidays, and Your Birthday off
* Generous Employee Discount on home furnishings
* Professional Development Opportunities
* Ashley Wellness Centers (location specific) and Medical Tourism
* Telehealth
* 401(k) and Profit Sharing
* Life Insurance

**Our Core Values**

* Honesty & Integrity
* Passion, Drive, Discipline
* Continuous Improvement/Operational Excellence
* Dirty Fingernail
* Growth Focused

To learn more about Ashley Furniture, our community engagement programs, environmental stewardship, and our core values, please visit our Corporate Social Responsibility information page:

https://www.ashleyfurniture.com/about-us/corporate-social-responsibility/report/

*We are an equal opportunity employer and provide a drug-free working environment. While Ashley appreciates the interest of all candidates only those meeting specific position requirements may be contacted. Principals Only.*

jobs.description:
**About Us**

Ashley is America's largest furniture manufacturer and a global retail leader. We’ve been committed to delivering beautiful, quality home furnishings at an accessible price point for over 75 years. Now, we're evolving our brand to meet the changing lifestyles of today's consumers. This is an exciting time to join the team and make a real impact. You'll be part of a transformation, working with passionate professionals who are reshaping an industry and creating meaningful connections between our products and the lives they enhance.

**Position Summary**

The Retail Experience Marketing Specialist is responsible for ensuring an exceptional in-store experience across bedding and electronics categories. This role manages all aspects of retail marketing execution, including signage coordination, vendor communication, store audits, and compliance with set standards. The specialist will serve as a key liaison between marketing, visual merchandising, vendors, and retail locations to ensure timely delivery and proper placement of all point-of-purchase (POP) materials.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Signage Execution**

o Coordinate ordering and delivery of signage for scheduled remodels, new store openings, and bedding or electronics campaigns.

o Brief in-store campaign POP assets, including signage placement and in-store video assets.

o Work with marketing to ensure all signage aligns with brand strategy and meets established standards.

o Maintain mattress gallery standards guide.

**Vendor & Store Coordination**

o Partner with construction team, merchants and vendors confirm timely shipment and arrival of marketing materials.

o Communicate with store teams to ensure proper POP placement and adherence to visual standards.

**Store Audits & Compliance**

o Conduct store audits to verify compliance with bedding and electronics visual standards.

o Provide detailed recaps and action plans for stores needing updates or corrections.

· Order Management

o Process bedding request forms submitted by stores for missing items required to meet standards.

o Place orders for additional signage or materials as needed to maintain compliance.

**Qualifications**

· Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Merchandising or related field (or equivalent experience).

· 3+ years of experience in retail marketing, visual merchandising, or related role.

· Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.

· Excellent communication and vendor management skills.

· Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite; experience with project management tools a plus.

· Ability to travel for store audits and openings 50% of the time.

**Key Competencies**

· Detail-oriented and highly organized.

· Strong problem-solving and follow-through skills.

· Collaborative team player with ability to work cross-functionally.

· Comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

**Our Core Values**

* Honesty & Integrity
* Passion, Drive, Discipline
* Continuous Improvement/Operational Excellence
* Dirty Fingernail
* Growth Focused

To learn more about Ashley Furniture, our community engagement programs, environmental stewardship, and our core values, please visit our Corporate Social Responsibility information page:

**Corporate Social Responsibility**

**https://www.ashleyfurniture.com/about-us/corporate-social-responsibility/report/**

We are an equal opportunity employer and provide a drug-free working environment. While Ashley appreciates the interest of all candidates only those meeting specific position requirements may be contacted. Principals Only.

jobs.description:
BASIC FUNCTION

The Sales Associate has the primary responsibility to maximize sales volume by growing existing business, developing new business, and providing the best possible customer service while enhancing Baker’s mission to offer the highest quality and service standards in the industry.

SPECIFIC RESPONSIBILITIES: Customer Communication

• Greet customers in a friendly, professional manner and in a timely fashion (5 minutes or less).

• Assist all customers as called in rotation.

• Create and maintain quotations for customers who come into the Showroom or who call for information.

• Follow up on all quotations within one week and on a weekly basis.

• Inform customers of price increases two weeks prior to the increase occurring.

• Inform customers of discontinued product, extended lead times, etc.

• Provide customers with product information.

• Follow up with a thank you note or phone call to all new customers who come into the Showroom.

• Assist the designer’s client when the designer is unavailable.

• Assist end users when available or when requested by the manager.

• Always maintain professional courtesy with associates and customers.

• Consistently practice proper telephone etiquette.

• Return phone calls within 24 hours.

• Communicate with Showroom receptionist as to whereabouts if absent from Showroom. Order Entry

• Enter all orders into the system within 24 hours of receipt of the deposit or the purchase order (for net 30 accounts). Include all necessary information on the purchase order (i.e., customer information, delivery information, product options, pricing, etc.)

• Provide an adequate explanation to the customer for all denials of special requests on product and/or delivery dates. Customer Service

• Review the purchase order once it is generated and confirm its receipt by the factory. Return checked purchase orders to the Customer Service Associate within 24 hours.

• Check factory acknowledgments and verify that the product has been ordered correctly. Report to the Customer Service Associate any incorrect acknowledgment with corrections in writing.

• Track receipt by factory of COM (customer’s own material) fabric, finish samples or any other materials required for completion of order.

• Review the Open Order Report and address any problems.

• Send thank you cards to customers after placing an order.

• Call customers periodically with updated information regarding status of the order.

• Once the product is shipped, contact customers to ensure the product and the service are acceptable.

• Partnering with Regional Account Coordinator, alert customers when product arrives at the distribution center that a remaining balance invoice will be sent. Inform customers that their payment may be sent prior to

2

receiving the invoice for more timely receipt of product. Apprise Net 30 customers when product arrives at distribution center and notify that shipment to the local receiver will occur shortly.

• Assist Regional Account Coordinator in handling customer claims; monitor progress of customer complaint resolutions and communicate updates to customers. Customer Development and Maintenance

• Provide personal accounts with information regarding current and upcoming Showroom events and sales.

• Provide customers with materials and catalogues for their libraries.

• Participate in design-oriented events to ensure visibility and contact with current and potential customers.

• Maintain updated customer information including contact data, special interests, etc.

• Maintain updated calendar of customer special dates (events, installations, publications, etc.).

• Identify and implement ways to prospect new customers and increase conversion of turns to personal accounts. Showroom Responsibilities

• Assist in the display maintenance of the showroom to ensure optimum showroom appearance.

• Assist other Sales Associates as necessary or as directed by the Showroom Manager.

• Assist in the maintenance of samples, tear sheets and resource files.

• Assist in product training and mentoring of new Sales Associates.

• Ensure catalogs and price lists are up to date.

• Product Knowledge

• Maintain knowledge of all vendor products, pricing, options, finishes, details, etc.

• Maintain thorough, up-to-date knowledge of all products, pricing, and local competition.

EDUCATIONAL AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:

Bachelor's Degree Preferred. Candidate will possess previous 3-5 years of high-end sales/customer experience, preferably in the furniture/design industry. Basic knowledge of the history of furniture design (periods, styles, designers, etc.) is preferred.

Baker is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.description:
**The Opportunity**Our retail expansion in the primary markets starts with hiring the best leaders. As a Sales/Operations Manager, you will focus on operational activities to grow the business. You will promote the Ballard Designs brand at every guest encounter and ensure your stellar team exemplifies brand values, standards, and experience. The dynamic energy from your leadership will increase company programs, increase sales, and set your store to exceed all expectations.  
  
You will report to the store leader.  
  
Your hiring location is **Tampa, Florida****Who We Are**Since 1982, Ballard Designs has offered a unique curation of home furnishings and décor from all periods and provenance. Its designers travel the world for inspiration, translating the latest fashion, color, and style trends into finely crafted products not found anywhere else. Ballard Designs is part of the Cornerstone brands - four interactive, aspirational home and apparel lifestyle brands that deliver inspirations that help customers enjoy, enhance, and celebrate life.  
  
**Your Impact**

* Perform a variety of operational activities, including scheduling, inventory management, backroom organization & store maintenance
* Experience with 'Division of Responsibility' understanding, competent in merchandise flow processes, including inspecting and receiving new merchandise and entering data into the inventory management system
* Manage the performance of the associates and provide feedback.
* Assure all back areas meet company standards of cleanliness and a safe work environment

**What You Bring**

* 3+ years of shipping and receiving management experience in the specialty retail industry
* Proficiency using Microsoft Word, Excel (can maintain complex spreadsheets), Outlook, Workday, Kronos, and POS Systems
* Lift and mobilize medium to large items, up to 50lbs
* Availability to work flexible schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays

Remote work is not permitted in NYC currently.  
  
#Onsite  
  
Our Total Rewards package includes benefits you’ll love such as competitive compensation, paid time off, an employee assistance program, parental leave, paid volunteer hours, and amazing company discounts! In our US market, you can also expect health care benefits starting on day 1, 401(k), and tuition reimbursement benefits. QVC Group is committed to inclusion and belonging for all and ensuring that our workplace provides equal employment opportunities for all team members and candidates and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local laws and regulations. As an equal opportunity employer, QVC Group is committed to a barrier-free employment process. If you need reasonable accommodations/support throughout, please contact us at workwithus@qvcgrp.com for assistance. If provided, salary ranges are a general guideline only, and actual salaries will vary and are based on factors such as a candidate's qualifications, skills, experience, and geographic location as well as business and market conditions.

jobs.description:
**Job Description**We are seeking an enthusiastic and driven individual to assist the management team in our Balsam Hill Studio retail store at Whalers Village in Lahaina, HI. In the full-time Sales Associate role, you will have the opportunity to help ensure that our customers experience the magic of Balsam Hill in an inspired holiday setting.  
  
The Sales Associate will support the store management team by fostering a positive work environment that ensures customer satisfaction, boosts productivity, and drives sales. From enhancing the customer shopping experience to assisting with store opening and closing, the Sales Associate is vital to the success of Balsam Hill Studio. We are particularly excited about candidates with a proven history of retail success and creating customer-centric shopping experiences!  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Assist customers and provide top notch service to ensure all patrons leave satisfied
* Assist with merchandising, cleaning, and restocking
* Gather customer feedback
* Achieve sales targets by generating revenue through effective sales strategies
* Perform opening/closing routines as needed
* Demonstrate exemplary customer service and selling skills

**What You Bring To The Table**

* 2+ years of retail experience preferred
* Strong communication skills with customers and sales staff
* Demonstrated time management, organizational and multi-tasking skills
* Passion for exemplary service
* Great sales skills: retail sales experience a strong plus
* Proficiency with iPads, basic computer skills, and basic data entry (data entry very minimal overall)
* Flexibility: willingness to perform other various duties as required

**Physical Requirements**

* Must be able to work onsite for every shift
* May assemble and disassemble Christmas trees and other decorations
* May lift and or move items up to forty pounds

**Notes:**The Sales Associate role is a full-time in-person position, expected to work around 40 hours per week.  
  
**About Us:** Balsam Brands is a global, eCommerce retailer with roots in holiday and home décor. We strive for excellence in everything we do and present a unique opportunity for those seeking to have a meaningful impact in a people-first company that values relationship building, authenticity, and doing the right thing. We have steadily growing teams in Boise, the Bay Area, Dublin, and the Philippines.  
  
Balsam Hill Studio, an extension of our holiday brand Balsam Hill®, reimagines souvenir shopping, offering premium ornaments unique to each store's location. **Job Description**

Balsam Hill is seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Interim Project Coordinator to support the execution of key ecommerce and strategic initiatives over a three-month period. This part-time, interim role is ideal for a flexible and organised professional who can manage multiple workstreams, coordinate stakeholders, and ensure timely delivery of project milestones across digital and business transformation projects.

This position reports to the General Manager and Business Lead, Europe. This is a part-time, hybrid in-office position located in our Dublin office, which will require you to work three days in-office (Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday).

To ensure sufficient overlap with functional and cross-functional team members globally, some flexibility with this role's regular work schedule will be required. Most of our teams have overlap with early morning and/or early evening PST. Specific scheduling needs for this role will be discussed in the initial interview.

**What you’ll do:**

* Coordinate and track progress across ecommerce and strategic project initiatives, ensuring alignment with timelines and deliverables.
* Support project leads by preparing updates, reports, and presentations for internal stakeholders and senior management.

* Liaise with cross-functional teams, including marketing, merchandising, operations, and IT, to ensure project milestones are achieved.

* Maintain project trackers, budgets, and performance dashboards.

* Proficient in Excel, PowerPoint, and common project management tools (e.g., Slack, Asana, Jira).
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Able to adapt quickly within a fast-paced, changing environment.
* Self-starter with the ability to work independently and manage workload effectively within part-time hours.
* Demonstrated AI literacy, enabling effective understanding, interaction, and critical evaluation of AI technologies and applications across diverse business functions

jobs.description:
**Job Description**The Director of eCommerce (Temporary) will play a significant role in building a best‐in‐class global eCommerce website and creating a superior home décor shopping experience. This role will be accountable for driving and monitoring our webstore performance via effective merchandising, A/B testing, personalization, and optimization projects. This person will be a key stakeholder in the creation of the eCommerce roadmap and a key contributor to our company roadmap and annual priorities.  
  
The Director of eCommerce (Temporary) will work closely with Product Management, UI/UX, Marketing, and Creative teams to build a conversion‐driven website design that supports the brand vision and seasonal campaigns and proves our brand value to our shoppers. This person will also work closely with Product Management and Technology teams to identify technology, processes, eCommerce software, and feature improvements that contribute to the overall growth and profitability of the business**.**This position reports to the VP of eCommerce and is based in our Redwood City office location. This role is expected to work in a hybrid model, which currently includes Monday, Tuesday, and Wednesday in-office.  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Guide and support a global team of eCommerce Merchandisers to deliver best in class shopping experiences on our international sites
* Oversee development of eCommerce site strategies including navigation, landing experiences, site search, and other tactical plans that will help meet and exceed conversion, revenue and profitability goals
* Participate in evaluating tool and systems opportunities that drive eCommerce features and efficiencies, including use of technology to deliver a best‐in‐class personalized merchandising experience
* Oversee eCommerce day‐to‐day responsibilities, including:
* Drive improvement for key page/category metrics (conversion, bounce, exit, revenue, engagement, etc.) through the optimization of online merchandising that enhances overall customer experience
* Drive innovation and optimization through testing and application of eCommerce best practices
* Monitor, meet, and report on eCommerce KPI's (conversion, bounce/exit, cart abandon, RPV, brand/category revenue, etc.) across devices, pages, and customer segments, and be able to explain the business drivers behind fluctuations in these metrics
* Collaborate with the Marketing, SEO, Merchants, Pricing, and Planning teams to define business goals for our brands to align on strategies that drive growth
* Partner with Creative by contributing to creative briefs, reviewing creative concepts against business goals, and identifying asset requirements
* Partner with Merchandising (physical product) to ensure that product goals and benefits are being translated onto our site in a way that is consistent with their strategies
* Partner with Product Management and Technology teams to ensure technical support for the execution of eCommerce projects and website operations
* Provide input for prioritization of eCommerce projects, bug fixes, and maintenance tasks that go to Website Operations, Creative, and/or Technology teams

**What You Bring To The Table**

* 14+ years of experience in eCommerce/Retail
* Exceptional analytical skills required
* Prior experience managing teams required; remote management preferred
* Ability to influence across functions and communicate across levels
* Prior experience in leading cross functional projects
* Experience in working with Creative, Product Management and/or Technology teams
* Bachelor’s Degree in Merchandising, Economics, General Business Management or equivalent

**Notes:** This is a temporary position, expected to work 40 hours per week and last through January 2026.  
  
**About Us:** Balsam Brands is a global, omnichannel retailer with roots in holiday and home décor. We strive for excellence in everything we do and present a unique opportunity for those seeking to have a meaningful impact in a people-first company that values relationship building, authenticity, and doing the right thing. We have steadily growing teams in Boise, the Bay Area, Dublin, the Philippines, Canada, and Mexico.  
  
The company's mission is to create joy together. We empower our team and partners to love what they do, provide products and experiences that inspire meaningful moments with family and friends, and give back to our families and communities in impactful ways. When you join Balsam Brands, you'll find a culture of caring people doing challenging work and building a welcoming workplace.  
  

* Check out our flagship brand, Balsam Hill: www.balsamhill.com
* Balsam Brands in Forbes: https://bit.ly/balsambrandsforbes2023
* Balsam Brands on LinkedIn: http://www.linkedin.com/company/balsam-brands/
* Glassdoor: https://bit.ly/balsambrands-glassdoor

**Benefits**At Balsam Brands, we strive to offer a competitive compensation and benefits package. For permanent, full-time team members, our current package includes:  
  

* Competitive compensation, including a cash-based incentive plan; salary is reviewed yearly and may be adjusted as part of the normal compensation review process
* Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage, with 100% of monthly premiums covered for team members, and 85%+ employer-paid premiums for other coverage tiers that include dependents
* Up to $2,000 annual funding toward HSA accounts
* Medical, transit, dependent care FSA
* Infertility coverage offered on all medical plans
* Generous parental leave program and flexible return options
* Company-paid life and AD&D insurance
* Company-paid short and long-term disability insurance
* 401(k) with dollar-for-dollar company match up to $4,000 per calendar year
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and other mental health and wellness perks
* Paid holidays, annual shutdown week, PTO, and volunteer time-off (VTO) packages
* Paid 5-week sabbatical leave after 10 years of employment
* Annual continuous learning benefit up to $1,000 per person, per fiscal year
* Up to $300 flexible reimbursement to support setup of new team member's work-from-home environment
* Generous team member merchandise discount
* Valuable extras: identity theft protection, subsidized parking, monthly wellness, pet insurance, accident & critical illness insurance

The base pay rate for this position is: $77-97 per hour.  
  
*At Balsam Brands, we strive to build a diverse, equitable, and inclusive team to fulfill our purpose to create joy together. Balsam Brands is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We encourage people from all backgrounds, ages, abilities, and experiences to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, ethnicity, religion, national origin, citizenship, marital or family status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy or caregiver status, veteran status, or any other legally protected status. jobs.description:
**Digital Marketing & Content Manager****Position Overview**The Digital Marketing & Content Manager will plan, assist with creation and oversee digital content to align with marketing goals. This role is responsible for analyzing performance of content/campaigns across social media channels. This includes maintaining content calendars and sharing information across internal and external teams. There will be a strong focus on preparing and leading the social media strategy to drive engagement and brand awareness. They will communicate events and assets to digital partners, licensed and open market partners.  
  
The manager will collaborate with the marketing team and other departments to develop online strategies that increase company brand awareness. They will make sure that all company communications have consistent messages across social and digital channels.  
  
They will help identify processes, techniques, and opportunities for improvement of communication of assets and events. This person will work closely with the marketing team, sales team, licensed and open market teams and outside agencies. They should be able to work collaboratively and effectively across the team while focusing on action and learning. They also will measure how effective communications strategies are and suggest improvements.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and lead a comprehensive content strategy that supports the business and marketing objectives
* Collaborate with copywriters, graphic designers and the marketing team to produce high-quality, on-brand content
* Create and manage content calendars, including scheduling and publishing organic posts
* Support content creation, including video/reels, interactive formats, and other digital assets
* Track, analyze, and report on content performance, providing insights and recommendations
* Manage influencer partnerships and evaluate ROI
* Stay current on industry trends, competitor activity, and consumer behavior

**Skills & Competencies**

* Expertise in social media strategy, execution, and performance analysis
* Proficiency in content formats including video, reels, interactive forms/features, and GIFs
* Strong project management skills with ability to lead cross-functional collaboration
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* High attention to detail, intellectual curiosity, and a self-motivated approach

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, communications, or related field
* 5-7 years of experience in digital marketing and social platform management
* Proven expertise with Meta, Pinterest, and TikTok, including content publishing and performance tracking
* Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint
* Hybrid work arrangement: partial remote flexibility with required in-office days at corporate HQ in Bassett, VA

*IND1 #ZR*

jobs.description:
Digital Marketing & Content Manager   
Position Overview   
The Digital Marketing & Content Manager will plan, assist with creation and oversee digital content to align with marketing goals. This role is responsible for analyzing performance of content/campaigns across social media channels. This includes maintaining content calendars and sharing information across internal and external teams. There will be a strong focus on preparing and leading the social media strategy to drive engagement and brand awareness. They will communicate events and assets to digital partners, licensed and open market partners.   
The manager will collaborate with the marketing team and other departments to develop online strategies that increase company brand awareness. They will make sure that all company communications have consistent messages across social and digital channels.   
They will help identify processes, techniques, and opportunities for improvement of communication of assets and events. This person will work closely with the marketing team, sales team, licensed and open market teams and outside agencies. They should be able to work collaboratively and effectively across the team while focusing on action and learning. They also will measure how effective communications strategies are and suggest improvements.   
Key Responsibilities

* Develop and lead a comprehensive content strategy that supports the business and marketing objectives
* Collaborate with copywriters, graphic designers and the marketing team to produce high-quality, on-brand content
* Create and manage content calendars, including scheduling and publishing organic posts
* Support content creation, including video/reels, interactive formats, and other digital assets
* Track, analyze, and report on content performance, providing insights and recommendations
* Manage influencer partnerships and evaluate ROI
* Stay current on industry trends, competitor activity, and consumer behavior

Skills & Competencies   

* Expertise in social media strategy, execution, and performance analysis
* Proficiency in content formats including video, reels, interactive forms/features, and GIFs
* Strong project management skills with ability to lead cross-functional collaboration
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* High attention to detail, intellectual curiosity, and a self-motivated approach

Required Qualifications   

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, communications, or related field
* 5-7 years of experience in digital marketing and social platform management
* Proven expertise with Meta, Pinterest, and TikTok, including content publishing and performance tracking
* Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint
* Hybrid work arrangement: partial remote flexibility with required in-office days at corporate HQ in Bassett, VA

jobs.description:
At Bob’s Discount Furniture, the Digital Content Manager (Temporary Role) plays a critical role in owning and optimizing our digital asset management (DAM) system while streamlining workflows and ensuring efficient content delivery across platforms. This role blends technical expertise, project management, and creative collaboration to drive efficiency, structure, and scalability within our growing content ecosystem.  
  
**What You’ll Bring To Bob’s**Success in this role requires a unique combination of technical, operational, and interpersonal skills. You will leverage your expertise in DAM systems, automation, and metadata structures to support end-to-end creative operations, while serving as a trainer, collaborator, and process optimizer.  
  
**Key Skills For Success****Core Competencies & Expertise**

* Content Metadata & Taxonomy: Skilled in developing and managing scalable metadata standards, taxonomy models, and folder structures to ensure intuitive and accessible content.
* Creative & Technical Tools: Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Premiere Pro) to collaborate with design teams and support asset formatting.
* Systems Integration: Knowledge of REST APIs and connectors for integrating DAM with marketing tools, repositories, and analytics dashboards.
* Project Management: Experience using tools like Asana, Trello, or Monday.com to support creative timelines, asset flow, and cross-team visibility.
* Compliance Awareness: Understanding of content rights, licensing, and accessibility requirements (including ADA compliance).

**Preferred Competencies & Skills**

* Strong communication and training skills to onboard and enable diverse stakeholders.
* Highly detail-oriented, organized, and process-driven, with the ability to scale complex systems simply.
* Background or interest in library sciences, content taxonomy, or metadata systems.
* Retail or e-commerce creative team experience.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 3–5 years of experience in digital asset management, creative operations, or marketing project coordination.

**Who We Are**At Bob’s, we have fun, we love what we do, and we’re growing fast! **Job Summary**The primary function of a Bobs Squad Support Associate is to represent Bob’s Discount Furniture and its products with honesty and integrity while providing exceptional support to guests through all stages of their journey. * Feeling under the weather, we’ve got you covered! We offer Nationally provided Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance
* Paid Vacation, Personal Days, Sick Days, Holidays, work anniversary and your Birthday! After all, your birthday should be a holiday

jobs.description:
At Bob’s Discount Furniture, the Digital Content Manager (Temporary Role) plays a critical role in owning and optimizing our digital asset management (DAM) system while streamlining workflows and ensuring efficient content delivery across platforms. This role blends technical expertise, project management, and creative collaboration to drive efficiency, structure, and scalability within our growing content ecosystem.  
  
**What You’ll Bring To Bob’s**Success in this role requires a unique combination of technical, operational, and interpersonal skills. You will leverage your expertise in DAM systems, automation, and metadata structures to support end-to-end creative operations, while serving as a trainer, collaborator, and process optimizer.  
  
**Key Skills For Success****Core Competencies & Expertise**

* Digital Asset Management (DAM): Proven experience with DAM platforms (Cloudinary preferred) including organization, tagging, archiving, rights management, and user onboarding/training.
* Workflow Optimization: Ability to analyze and streamline creative workflows, leveraging low-code tools (Zapier, Power Automate, Airtable Automations) and light scripting (Python) to increase efficiency.
* Content Metadata & Taxonomy: Skilled in developing and managing scalable metadata standards, taxonomy models, and folder structures to ensure intuitive and accessible content.
* Creative & Technical Tools: Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Premiere Pro) to collaborate with design teams and support asset formatting.
* Systems Integration: Knowledge of REST APIs and connectors for integrating DAM with marketing tools, repositories, and analytics dashboards.
* Project Management: Experience using tools like Asana, Trello, or Monday.com to support creative timelines, asset flow, and cross-team visibility.
* Compliance Awareness: Understanding of content rights, licensing, and accessibility requirements (including ADA compliance).

**Preferred Competencies & Skills**

* Strong communication and training skills to onboard and enable diverse stakeholders.
* Highly detail-oriented, organized, and process-driven, with the ability to scale complex systems simply.
* Background or interest in library sciences, content taxonomy, or metadata systems.
* Retail or e-commerce creative team experience.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 3–5 years of experience in digital asset management, creative operations, or marketing project coordination.
* Demonstrated technical skills in low-code platforms, workflow automation, and light scripting.
* Familiarity with cross-functional collaboration in creative or marketing environments.

**Who We Are**At Bob’s, we have fun, we love what we do, and we’re growing fast! You will:  
  

* Lead simplification and automation efforts to reduce friction in creative workflows.

* Paid Vacation, Personal Days, Sick Days, Holidays, work anniversary and your Birthday! After all, your birthday should be a holiday

jobs.description:
At Bob’s Discount Furniture, the Digital Content Manager (Temporary Role) plays a critical role in owning and optimizing our digital asset management (DAM) system while streamlining workflows and ensuring efficient content delivery across platforms. This role blends technical expertise, project management, and creative collaboration to drive efficiency, structure, and scalability within our growing content ecosystem.  
  
**What You’ll Bring To Bob’s**Success in this role requires a unique combination of technical, operational, and interpersonal skills. You will leverage your expertise in DAM systems, automation, and metadata structures to support end-to-end creative operations, while serving as a trainer, collaborator, and process optimizer.  
  
**Key Skills For Success****Core Competencies & Expertise**

* Digital Asset Management (DAM): Proven experience with DAM platforms (Cloudinary preferred) including organization, tagging, archiving, rights management, and user onboarding/training.
* Workflow Optimization: Ability to analyze and streamline creative workflows, leveraging low-code tools (Zapier, Power Automate, Airtable Automations) and light scripting (Python) to increase efficiency.
* Content Metadata & Taxonomy: Skilled in developing and managing scalable metadata standards, taxonomy models, and folder structures to ensure intuitive and accessible content.
* Creative & Technical Tools: Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Premiere Pro) to collaborate with design teams and support asset formatting.
* Systems Integration: Knowledge of REST APIs and connectors for integrating DAM with marketing tools, repositories, and analytics dashboards.
* Project Management: Experience using tools like Asana, Trello, or Monday.com to support creative timelines, asset flow, and cross-team visibility.
* Compliance Awareness: Understanding of content rights, licensing, and accessibility requirements (including ADA compliance).

**Company Description**

California Closets Alberta is seeking talented, driven professionals who are passionate about interior design and exceptional client service. As a Sales & Design Consultant, you’ll join a collaborative team that values craftsmanship, precision, and creating spaces that truly enhance our clients’ lives.

You’ll bring a strong sales mindset, a consultative approach, and a genuine enthusiasm for design. We offer comprehensive training and ongoing development to help you thrive in a role that blends creativity, relationship-building, and strong earning potential.

This is an exciting opportunity to grow your career while contributing to a team that transforms homes with care and expertise.

 **Job Description**  

* Represent the brand professionally with a confident, warm, and solutions-driven approach
* Conduct in-home or virtual consultations to complete detailed needs analyses
* Design custom organizational solutions using CAD software (laptop/iPad provided)
* Deliver a consultative sales experience that focuses on win-win outcomes
* Attend monthly sales and skills-development meetings
* Maintain consistent follow-up with clients and collaborate with the installation team to ensure seamless project completion
* Cultivate referrals and repeat business through excellent client relationships

  
  **Qualifications**

The ideal candidate will bring:

* Experience or education in interior design or a strong ability to translate client needs into design driven sales solutions
* Proven success in sales or customer facing roles where relationship building and trust directly drive repeat and referral business
* Demonstrated ability to consistently achieve or surpass sales targets, with a strong focus on closing and revenue growth
* Confidence in promoting and selling premium products
* Proficiency with basic computer programs; CAD experience is an asset
* Creativity paired with meticulous attention to detail and a focus on quality
* Ability to manage multiple projects in a dynamic environment
* A collaborative, team-oriented mindset
* Class 5 Driver’s License and access to a personal vehicle

  
  **Additional Information**

**Compensation & Benefits**

* Full-time, Monday-Friday with some evenings and occasional weekends
* Ability to work in Edmonton showroom
* 12 weeks of paid, on- the- job training
* Benefits after 3 months: Dental, extended health care and health spending account
* Commission and bonus-based pay structure

**What we provide:**

At California Closets, we invest in your success:

* **Flexible Schedule**: Split schedule including some evenings, weekend and showroom shifts

* **Training and Development:** Extensive onboarding, 10 weeks of classroom training and on-going coaching
* **Competitive Pay**: Commission- based structure, bonuses and allowances for fuel and cell phone
* **Employee Perks:** Employee discount program

**Why Join Us?** Be part of a team that values inclusivity, collaboration, and innovation. At California Closets, we’re passionate about creating beautiful, functional spaces – and equally passionate about the people who make that possible. Your work will make a meaningful difference in the lives of our clients, one space at a time.

jobs.description:
**Company Description**Founded in 1978, California Closets has built a reputation as the leader and design authority in premium space management, delivering custom-designed organizational solutions and exceptional service. We believe home is more than just a place — it should be a source of creativity, comfort, and connection. From beautiful walk-in closets and entertainment centers to versatile pantries and home offices, we design custom storage solutions that add value to your life and home by making space for what belongs. Think of it as ‘practical magic.’  
  
**Job Description**The Sales Supervisor role focuses on ensuring that company sales goals are met or exceeded including achieving all key business metrics while following the California Closets policies and procedures. This role ensures that the designers are delivering on the California Closets standards of excellence with each and every customer. The Sales Supervisor also collaborates with the Sales Manager to ensure that the process flow is being followed and delivering on a high standard of customer service at all touchpoints.  
  
**What We Offer**California Closets has both company-owned and franchise locations. This location is a franchise, therefore earns the following benefits:  
  

* A fun, creative, and inclusive work environment
* Compensation is Salary plus a commission based on sales. Approximately $75k annually.
* Health insurance – Medical, and Dental
* Paid Vacation and Sick time
* Simple IRA retirement plan with company match
* Company phone number

Company-owned locations may offer different benefits.  
  
**Essential Functions**

* Coach and mentor, an assigned team of Design Consultants ensuring all company revenue goals and key performance indicators are met or exceeded through monthly (Goal Setting & Review Meetings) GS&R’s.
* Ensure direct reports are delivering on an exception customer experience with every customer touch point and follow up on completed procedures per company policy
* Performance manages underperformers following performance management guidelines to improve results including detailed documentation, may have to include HR and General Manager.
* Collaborate with Sales Manager to ensure all mandatory training is completed as per training strategy for new and on-going training and development.
* Working in collaboration with the Sales Manager to ensure the assigned Design Team has the appropriate mix of company leads and self-generated leads.
* Work with Design Consultants to create a plan for driving self-generated leads.
* Manage day-to-day performance of all sales team members
* Co-Manage sales contests and incentive programs and collaborate with the Sales Manager on creation and tracking.
* Working in collaboration with Sales Manager to co-schedule and co-facilitate monthly Sales Meeting including coordination with guest speakers.
* Analyze sales data and develop strategy to address areas of opportunity.
* Monitor and enforce sales team’s participation in local industry meetings and functions (i.e. BIA, Chamber of Commerce, and ASID).

**Qualifications**

* High school diploma and/or GED, some college education preferred
* Interior design education, direct industry experience or proven passion for home décor.
* 5+ years of direct selling consultative sales experience within a business to consumer environment, preferably in high-end furniture, design showrooms, or luxury retail environments
* 3+ years of management/leadership experience
* Proven track record of leading a team to exceed sales quotas and sales metrics

**Additional Information***We are an equal opportunity employer.*All your information will be kept confidential.  
  
CA Privacy Policy - California Privacy Policy - California Closets  
  
Terms and Conditions: https://www.californiaclosets.com/terms-conditions/

jobs.description:
**Company Description**Founded in 1978, California Closets has built a reputation as the leader and design authority in premium space management, delivering custom-designed organizational solutions and exceptional service. We believe home is more than just a place — it should be a source of creativity, comfort, and connection. From beautiful walk-in closets and entertainment centers to versatile pantries and home offices, we design custom storage solutions that add value to your life and home by making space for what belongs. Think of it as ‘practical magic.’  
  
**Job Description**We’re seeking a Senior Salesforce Marketing Cloud Specialist who is a data-driven decision maker and marketing enthusiast to help drive our email marketing program. The ideal candidate has a strong track record of leveraging Salesforce Marketing Cloud to deploy technically-advanced email campaigns that enhance customer engagement and drive business results. With a passion to dive deep, this candidate has a strong technical background and project management skills with attention to detail, and a track record of transforming email marketing performance data into digestible, actionable insights. You’ll work cross-functionally with marketing, analytics, and CRM teams to create advanced customer journeys, automated workflows, dynamic content, and system integrations. The ideal candidate is an expert in Salesforce Marketing Cloud tools, scripting languages, and marketing automation best practices.  
  
We foster a values-based, collaborative environment and are seeking candidates who know how to drive growth while building deep partnerships. As a key driver of California Closets’ growth, this role works in partnership with cross-functional teams, and drives the results for a high-impact, high-visibility marketing channel, offering significant opportunities to make a meaningful impact on meeting our business objectives. The Senior Salesforce Marketing Cloud Specialist will report to the Senior Director, Relationship Marketing (CRM).  
  
Pay - $95K +  
  
**TECHNICAL EXECUTION**

* Advanced experience building, managing, and optimizing email campaigns specifically within Salesforce Marketing Cloud
* Hands-on experience leveraging Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Audience Builder, and Content Builder to deploy personalized, dynamic campaign flows and automations and create advanced multi-step customer journeys
* Create and troubleshoot automated workflows and data processes to support real-time, triggered messaging
* Proficient with building Data Extensions, conducting data imports and exports, and utilizing AMPscript to populate personalized attributes into emails
* Support integration with Marketing Cloud Connect and integrating SFMC with Salesforce CRM for triggered sends and real-time personalization
* Expert in Salesforce Marketing Cloud data architecture, including Contact Builder, Data Extensions, and Data Views
* Working knowledge of html, CSS, AMPscript, and responsive design

**EMAIL TRAFFIC AND PROJECT MANAGEMENT**

* Submit creative briefs and partner with cross-functional teams to take emails from concept to delivery
* Help develop and maintain the monthly/quarterly email content calendar in collaboration with creative and marketing teams
* Proficiency in Figma for email design collaboration, proofing, and QA
* Thoroughly QA all email assets (email lists, subject lines, content blocks, links, dynamic fields, and imaging) across multiple devices and email clients before launch to ensure successful execution

**REPORTING**

* Strong analytical capabilities with expertise in email data analysis and performance reporting
* Experience analyzing performance metrics and creating detailed campaign reports to translate insights into actionable improvements
* Proficient with using Salesforce Marketing Cloud Intelligence Reports to create dashboards and visualizations
* Expertise using Google Analytics (G4) or similar web analytics platform to leverage data and metrics to drive campaign improvements

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Analytics, or related field
* Salesforce Certified Marketing Cloud Email Specialist
* Salesforce Certified Marketing Cloud Administrator
* 5-7 years of professional hands-on email marketing experience, ideally at an agency or within a premium lifestyle brand
* Strong experience with Excel for data manipulation, charts and pivot tables

**Additional Information**Find us on Facebook, YouTube, and Instagram  
  
*We are an equal opportunity employer. We E-Verify.*All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.description:
**Company Description**Founded in 1978, California Closets has built a reputation as the leader and design authority in premium space management, delivering custom-designed organizational solutions and exceptional service. We believe home is more than just a place — it should be a source of creativity, comfort, and connection. From beautiful walk-in closets and entertainment centers to versatile pantries and home offices, we design custom storage solutions that add value to your life and home by making space for what belongs. Think of it as ‘practical magic.’  
  
**Job Description**We are seeking a strategic Senior Growth Marketing Manager with a strong focus on Paid Search including Bing and Google Paid Search, Demand Gen, Performance Max, and YouTube campaigns. This role will be responsible for using data-driven insights to develop and own paid search strategies, manage media budgets, drive campaign execution, and work cross-functionally to achieve growth and ROI objectives. You understand the full search landscape to identify opportunities where paid and organic search can work together to maximize performance.  
  
We are seeking a creatively strategic Senior Growth Marketing Manager with a strong focus on Paid Search including Bing and Google Paid Search, Demand Gen, Performance Max and YouTube campaigns. This role will be responsible for using data-driven insights to develop and own paid search strategies, manage media budgets, drive campaign execution, and work cross-functionally to achieve growth and ROI objectives. While this role is focused on paid search, we’re seeking a candidate that is aware of the greater paid digital ecosystem including broadcast, streaming and OTT advertising, paid social, affiliate marketing and their potential impacts on paid search performance. The ideal candidate has a passion for problem-solving, a data-first mindset, and excellent communication skills. You will be part of the Growth Marketing team—a collaborative group of marketers working to expand brand awareness and generate demand for California Closets through conversations with the customer. Optimizing their brand experience from awareness through first contact with us.  
  
Base salary for this range is $130k - $150k + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. This is a remote position, however there is occasionally travel required about 3-5x per year.  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Ownership role in the planning, management, and execution of all California Closets Paid Search campaigns, including but not limited to account setup, development and implementation of strategies, campaign structure, budget management, bidding strategies and invoice and billing management
* Experience managing budgets more than $10M, with an aptitude for managing market-specific billing details and reporting these charges to internal finance teams
* Actively direct and manage a digital agency to define, execute and measure marketing campaigns to maximize efficient customer growth for existing and new paid media channels, including paid search (SEM), YouTube video and display, programmatic, and retargeting
* Actively direct and manage digital agency efforts to conduct keyword research, competitive analysis, and audience targeting to identify growth opportunities and mitigate risks
* Have a true love of data and problem solving. Know what data to pull to obtain needed insights and be skilled at interpreting the data and knowing where and how to dig deeper to uncover anomalies, unexpected outcomes and key performance insights
* Review paid search and YouTube campaign performance by market/DMA and work directly with local business owners & managing operators to adjust strategies to align with their business specific objectives
* Meet and exceed monthly volume and ROAS targets by driving continuous improvement and experimentation of new optimization concepts and tactics
* Meet regularly with agency and platform account teams to assess account performance, and to ensure optimal solution adoption while continually evolving strategies in tandem with the rapidly shifting paid search landscape
* Partner with digital agency to monitor new opportunities within the Google and Microsoft Ads platforms to test and optimize accounts
* As the driving force behind our YouTube efforts, you’ll create a data-driven YouTube advertising strategy that compliments California Closets overall business goals
* Conduct in-depth post-campaign analysis, test plans for new user acquisition initiatives, and measure performance to identify testing opportunities across paid search and YouTube
* Collaborate across levels and functions within the Growth, Tech, Operations, Solutions and Brand teams to support company growth initiatives
* Develop creative and innovative solutions for how to leverage paid search and YouTube for customer acquisition with a willingness to test new strategies and tactics
* Derive critical insights from data (front-end performance metrics from search engine platforms and back-end California Closets actions) and synthesize recommendations to deliver improvements to campaign performance
* Proven ability to seek cross channel insights by conducting attribution analysis to understand how the market specific media mix impacts paid search performance, regarding new/returning visitor volume and quality
* Proactively seek ongoing education with the very latest industry trends and advancements in paid search, AI and all other aspects of modern digital marketing
* Ensure that your efforts and those of 3rd party partners adhere to the latest corporate privacy and data governance policies

**Qualifications**

* 7+ years of Paid Search experience managing and optimizing campaigns in Google Paid Search and Microsoft Ads.
* Hands-on experience managing and optimizing YouTube video campaigns.
* Google and Microsoft Ads certifications.
* Advanced proficiency in Google Analytics (GA4).
* Strong skills in Excel (macros, charts, pivot tables) and Tableau or similar BI platforms for data manipulation and visualization.
* Proven experience with A/B testing and iterative campaign optimization.
* Detail-oriented with a passion for creating processes to manage multiple campaigns and track location/franchise-specific strategies.
* Ability to use data and metrics to solve problems, support assumptions, and identify opportunities.
* Track record of exceeding performance goals through analysis, problem-solving, and strategic execution.

**Additional Information**Find us on Facebook, YouTube, and Instagram  
  
*We are an equal opportunity employer. We E-Verify.*All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

**Job Description**We are seeking a strategic Senior Growth Marketing Manager with a strong focus on Paid Search including Bing and Google Paid Search, Demand Gen, Performance Max, and YouTube campaigns. This role will be responsible for using data-driven insights to develop and own paid search strategies, manage media budgets, drive campaign execution, and work cross-functionally to achieve growth and ROI objectives. You understand the full search landscape to identify opportunities where paid and organic search can work together to maximize performance.  
  
While this role is focused on paid search, we’re seeking a candidate that is aware of the greater paid digital ecosystem including broadcast, streaming and OTT advertising, paid social, affiliate marketing and their potential impacts on paid search performance. The ideal candidate has a passion for problem-solving, a data-first mindset, and excellent communication skills. You will be part of the Growth Marketing team—a collaborative group of marketers working to expand brand awareness and generate demand for California Closets through conversations with the customer, optimizing their brand experience from awareness through first contact.  
  
Base salary for this range is $130k - $150k + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. This is a remote position, however there is occasionally travel required about 3-5x per year.  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead planning, management, and execution of all California Closets Paid Search campaigns, including account setup, strategy development, campaign structure, budget management, bidding strategies, and invoice/billing oversight.
* Manage budgets exceeding $10M, including market-specific billing details and reporting to internal finance teams.
* Direct and manage digital agency to define, execute, and measure marketing campaigns across paid media channels including SEM, YouTube video and display, programmatic, and retargeting.
* Guide agency efforts in keyword research, competitive analysis, and audience targeting to uncover growth opportunities and mitigate risks.
* Leverage SEO insights to inform keyword strategy, landing page relevance, and overall search visibility.
* Demonstrate a passion for data and problem-solving, with the ability to extract insights, interpret anomalies, and identify key performance trends.
* Review campaign performance by market/DMA and collaborate with local business owners and managing operators to align strategies with specific objectives.
* Drive continuous improvement and experimentation to meet and exceed monthly volume and ROAS targets.
* Engage regularly with agency and platform account teams to assess performance, adopt optimal solutions, and evolve strategies in response to the dynamic paid search landscape.
* Develop and execute a data-driven YouTube advertising strategy aligned with California Closets’ business goals.
* Collaborate across Growth, Tech, Operations, Solutions, and Brand teams to ensure alignment of paid search initiatives with company growth initiatives & business objectives.
* Conduct attribution analysis to understand how media mix impacts paid search performance, including visitor volume and quality.
* Maintain awareness of SEO trends and algorithm updates to ensure paid search strategies complement organic efforts.
* Monitor industry trends and competitor activities to identify opportunities for innovation and growth in paid search advertising.
* Ensure compliance with corporate privacy and data governance policies for all internal and third-party efforts.

**Job Description**We’re seeking a Senior Salesforce Marketing Cloud Specialist who is a data-driven decision maker and marketing enthusiast to help drive our email marketing program. You’ll work cross-functionally with marketing, analytics, and CRM teams to create advanced customer journeys, automated workflows, dynamic content, and system integrations. The ideal candidate is an expert in Salesforce Marketing Cloud tools, scripting languages, and marketing automation best practices.  
  
We foster a values-based, collaborative environment and are seeking candidates who know how to drive growth while building deep partnerships. As a key driver of California Closets’ growth, this role works in partnership with cross-functional teams, and drives the results for a high-impact, high-visibility marketing channel, offering significant opportunities to make a meaningful impact on meeting our business objectives. **REPORTING**

* Strong analytical capabilities with expertise in email data analysis and performance reporting
* Experience analyzing performance metrics and creating detailed campaign reports to translate insights into actionable improvements

* Expertise using Google Analytics (G4) or similar web analytics platform to leverage data and metrics to drive campaign improvements

**Essential Functions**

* Coach and mentor, an assigned team of Design Consultants ensuring all company revenue goals and key performance indicators are met or exceeded through monthly (Goal Setting & Review Meetings) GS&R’s.

* Performance manages underperformers following performance management guidelines to improve results including detailed documentation, may have to include HR and General Manager.

* Work with Design Consultants to create a Personal Marketing Plan and/or a plan for self-generated leads.
* Manage day-to-day performance of all sales team members
* Co-Manage sales contests and incentive programs and collaborate with GM on creation and tracking.
* Working in collaboration with the rest of the Sales Leadership team, co-schedule and co-facilitate monthly Sales Meeting including coordination with guest speakers and head office personnel.
* Analyze sales data and develop strategy to address areas of opportunity.
* Monitor and enforce sales team’s participation in local industry meetings and functions (i.e. BIA, Chamber of Commerce, and ASID).
* Monitor and enforce sales team’s attendance at the monthly sales meetings.
* Ensure correct usage of CRM (dashboard & SalesForce) including quality of data entry, statuses etc.

* Potential involvement in initial and follow up interviews
* Potentially coordinate your assigned Designers’ access to websites (CC email, Paylocity, CC 360, SalesForce, Dashboard, Slack, Digideck, DocuSign, Zoom, Sharepoint), materials (Computer, iPad, CAD key, Business Cards, branded materials and supplies) and samples (Designer Bags, Finish boxes).
* Ensure all mandatory training is completed as per training strategy for new training and development including classroom and CC 360 courses.

Qualifications  
  

* High school diploma and/or GED, some college education preferred
* Interior design education, direct industry experience or proven passion for home décor.
* 5+ years of direct selling consultative sales experience within a business to consumer environment, preferably in high-end furniture, design showrooms, or luxury retail environments
* 3+ years of management/leadership experience
* Proven track record of leading a team to exceed sales quotas and sales metrics

Additional Information
