jobs.description:
**Company Description**Founded in 1978, California Closets has built a reputation as the leader and design authority in premium space management, delivering custom-designed organizational solutions and exceptional service. We believe home is more than just a place — it should be a source of creativity, comfort, and connection. From beautiful walk-in closets and entertainment centers to versatile pantries and home offices, we design custom storage solutions that add value to your life and home by making space for what belongs. Think of it as ‘practical magic.’  
  
**Job Description**We’re looking for a motivated go-getter who wants to make a real difference in sales and marketing. In this role, you’ll team up with our Sales Manager and General Manager to drive leads, grow opportunities, and keep things moving in the Atlanta market. You’ll be hands-on with marketing campaigns, events, and the behind-the-scenes coordination that makes our sales team shine. You’ll also get the chance to work on a variety of projects that will help you build new skills and sharpen your toolkit. Every day will look a little different, so if you’re eager to learn, ready to jump in, and excited to grow your career, we want to hear from you!  
  
**What We Offer**California Closets has both company-owned and franchise locations. This location is company-owned, therefore earns the following benefits:  
  

* Health insurance – Medical, Dental, and Vision
* PTO days and paid holidays
* 401K retirement plan with company match
* 40 hours/week with overtime potential
* Grow your career with us – many promotional opportunities are available

Franchises are independently owned and operated and may offer different benefits.  
  
**Essential Functions**

* When in a showroom, serves as first contact to greet all clients who visit our showroom, including assisting the clients with signing our guestbook and offering refreshments as necessary.
* Responsible for lead management in an efficient and detailed manner for our Design Consultants, using CRM.
* Responsible for answering incoming phone calls & emails to either the local scheduling office or local showrooms and address client needs.
* Updating the local marketing including showroom hours on the website, social media, Yelp and Google reviews.
* Updating and maintaining Design Consultant bios on the website.
* Running and distributing weekly reports for rescheduled consults, open status jobs, and “pending” client lists.
* Collaborating with Design Consultants to follow up on the “pending” client lists.
* Sending out “client anniversary” marketing campaigns.
* Will assign Trade Partners for the Trade program.
* Managing “Digideck / Hepburn” activities including local photos and keeping the “offer list current based on market.
* Responsible for sales administrative duties including, online social media support, warranty, trade packages, additional sales support (add-ons), and other clerical responsibilities.
* When in the showroom, maintains the showroom at the direction of their leader in accordance with the maintenance and cleanliness checklist. This includes opening and closing of the Showroom duties.
* Tracking and maintaining client traffic reports and distributing to leaders.
* Maintains an adequate supply of the Design Consultant and Showroom samples in the showroom at all times.
* Assists the Sales Manager with the ongoing education and training of the Design Consultants with Central Scheduling, as needed.
* Responsible for assisting General Manager and Sales Manager with any administrative needs that may arise.
* \*Some locations may include CAD Design Support as part of this role including:

+ Review and mentor Design Consultants in CAD and Design process, providing guidance
+ Train new Design Consultants Advanced CAD Design with the assistance of the Sales Manager
+ Weekly office hours and individual meetings with Design Consultants
+ Heavy focus with Design Consultants who’s defect rate is higher than 30%.
+ Support team and sales manager with product training as needed, may included CAD/Design presentation in monthly Sales Meetings.

Qualifications  
  
**Competencies:**

* Decisions will affect others within the functional area.
* Understanding a range of routine work procedures and their impacts on internal and external work areas, requiring a longer period of job training.
* Internal Communication that includes CCO team and/or corporate.
* Requires the ability to elaborate on routine information and ensure understanding.
* Problems encountered are routine, somewhat repetitive, and generally solved by following clear directions and procedures.
* Work is guided by specific procedures and well-defined instructions. The team member would normally not deviate without seeking advice or guidance.

**SKILLS & ABILITIES:**

* High school diploma and/or GED
* Associates Degree related to business & or sales administration from an accredited college or university preferred
* 1-2 years of experience of administrative and/or customer service experience in construction and/or in the home renovations/improvement industry – preferably within a luxury brand environment
* Advanced knowledge with internal CC CAD system.
* Strong communication, interpersonal and presentation skills
* Ability to communicate politely, clearly and professionally with clients
* Ability to work quickly and accurately data entry
* Calendar management / regional scheduling experience preferred
* Must be able to adapt to a fast-paced, changing environment and exercise independent though to challenges and improve the status quo.
* Self-starter with a positive attitude, ability to manage own schedule and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment
* Detail oriented, organized and time management skills
* Ability to provide an exceptional client experience aligned to the company values
* Must possess strong critical thinking, problem solving, time management, and organizational skills with the ability to work under pressure
* Strong multi-tasking, time management, and prioritization capabilities
* Must possess an unwavering commitment to foster a safe and event-free work environment
* Tech savvy with the ability to quickly learn and apply various business systems (CAD, Epicor, Salesforce, Microsoft Office, etc)

**Certificates & Licenses:**Successfully complete a Background check  
  
**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

* Ability to stand on feet for minimum 4–6-hour shift.
* Minimal sitting in front of a computer for periods of time
* Ability to operate office equipment using hands and fingers, handle or feel, and reach with hands and arms
* Minimal bending, squatting, kneeling, stretching, twisting, reaching, and climbing
* Ability to frequently talk and hear
* Ability to reach with hand and arms and grasp objects
* Flexible work schedule: ability to work evenings and weekends

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**Company office and/or showroom location  
  
Additional Information  
  
Find us on Facebook, YouTube, and Instagram  
  
*We are an equal opportunity employer. We E-Verify.*All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.  
  
#GA148

jobs.description: POSITION SUMMARYThe Sales and Design Consultant provides an in-home customer experience by designing and selling closets, cabinetry, home offices, garages, media centers and other storage solutions for homes.Our in-home customer experience includes taking multiple meetings per week where designer will measure space and design on-site with proprietary CAD software. Designer is also responsible for working with internal team on ordering necessary materials, scheduling installations and managing all sold projects to completion.Designers are responsible for meeting monthly and yearly sales goals set forth by closing business from assigned leads and self-generated leads.ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONSBrand Experience Responsibilities:-       Design Consultants play a critical role in building strong relationships with customers and representing the brand through demonstration of our Company Core Values while also executing all steps in the Facilitative Sales Cycle-       Commute using personal vehicle to customers’ home for a needs analysis to design a unit-       Manage both company and self-generated leads from start to finish. This includes a 24-hour turnaround time for introductory call, designing on-the-spot during consultations, uploading required documents into CXM (Salesforce), follow up with the customers and collaborating with installation team to ensure job completion, visiting installations to ensure effective project management and expectations align with contracted project.-       Design Consultants are required to complete an average of 12-15 new client consultations per month-       Create goals and manage your “Personal Marketing Plan”, for self-generated leads while building relationships with existing customers and pursue referrals/repeat business-       Monitor your performance metrics at all times in company’s prescribed software (monthly, YTD, close rate, average sale and sales per consultation)-       Meet weekly for 1:1 with sales leader and regularly review performance metrics. Prepare for mid-month projection via Goal, Setting, and Review meetings-       Design Consultants are required to maintain the highest standards of quality in every aspect of their work to ensure customer satisfaction.-       Respond to all internal and external emails/phone calls within a 24-hour period within business working hours.-       Follow and understand industry trends including fashion, design, and organization.Technology Responsibilities:-       Utilize the Cal Closets Retail Inc. cloud-based software (SalesForce) for managing contracts, opportunities, scheduling meetings, and documenting every contact and next step with customers.-       Maintain customer records: (including but not limited to…) All contact related correspondence, interaction, and clear next steps; relevant documents related to each customer; identify, evaluate, and design solutions to meet the needs of the customers; accurately design project(s) for customers through CAD program; maintain high quality standards and assure each project is completed correctly, in addition, partnering with national plan review team for complexity meetings and/or making changes to the design. Request support from the sales leadership team if encountering difficulties with customer designs or project complexities.Design Consultant Availability Expectations:-       Attend company meetings or functions as required, including monthly GS&Rs, monthly sales meetings, and sales training meetings.-       Available for appointments 5 days a week. This includes one evening a week (after 5pm), and 2 appointments two weekend days (Saturday or Sunday) per month.-       Consultation expectations: 4 new appointments per week, depending on the volume of incoming leads, the number of sales consultants, workload, and performance. There is no guarantee of a minimum number of leads from Corporate Lead Sources; therefore, may need to rely on Personal Marketing and Prospecting (PMP) efforts to meet monthly consultation expectations.-       Work with Sales Manager to set minimum 40 “Operating Hours” per week in applicable software systems. This open availability specifies windows for new opportunities and blocks of time set aside for designing, personal marketing, networking, and follow-up appointments.-       Showroom duty requirements: Work 2-3 showroom shifts per month.-       Participate in a rotating work schedule in the local Showroom(s) and meet clients in the showroom agreed upon appointment times with customers, as required.-       Make every effort to accommodate reasonable customer requests for meeting days, times, and locations. Appointments are scheduled primarily based on customer needs, considering factors such as customer availability, drive time, designer availability, and performance.POSITION QUALIFICATIONSCompetencies:-       Understanding a range of work procedures and practices, some of which are non-routine, which require a base level of specialized/technical knowledge. Acquired through some formal training or equivalent experience.-       Requires the skill to persuade, influence, and/or negotiate with others on a regular basis-       External communication that includes clients, vendors, gov’t agencies, and service providers-       Internal Communication that includes manufacturing, corporate, and other CCO teams.-       Modifies existing processes in order to resolve issues.-       Significantly enhances entire existing processes, systems, or products.-       Work will be guided by company policies and strategies. The team member has freedom to act independently to achieve objectives within appropriate guidelines, practices, and precedents. The team member is responsible for setting annual objectives for their area.SKILLS & ABILITIES-       College Degree Preferred-       High School Diploma Required-       Interior design education, direct industry experience or proven passion for home décor-       2+ years of direct selling consultative sales experience within a business to consumer environment, preferably in high-end furniture, design showrooms, or luxury retail environments-       Ability to learn new software programs quickly; Tech savvy with the ability to quickly learn and apply various business systems (CAD, Salesforce, Microsoft Office, etc)-       Ability to provide an exceptional client experience aligned to the company values.-       Professional and assertive, consultative sales skills.-       Detail oriented, organized and with time and project management skills.-       Self-starter and ability to manage own schedule working remotely.-       Understanding the importance of repeat customers, referrals and cultivating relationships.-       Experience in customer service or retail sales of any kind, where the consultant is the reason for repeat clients.-       The ability to be consistently inspirational and create delightful customer and brand experiences.-       A proven record of sales success.-       Confidently able to sell and promote a product you might not be able to personally afford.-       Team player with the ability to manage a portfolio of projects and clients of different complexity in a dynamic environment.-       Proven customer service / support experience-       Thorough knowledge of millwork and related materials and hardware (i.e door styles, finishes, decorative hardware, countertop surfacing, glass or molding)-       Strong communication, interpersonal and presentation skills-       Strong phone contact handling skills and active listening-       Demonstrates excellent critical thinking and reasoning abilities to identify and resolve potential issues.-       Ability to work with all employees to create a forward-moving, positive work environment.-       Proficient in math (i.e. Fractions and unit measurements)-       Must possess an unwavering commitment to foster a safe and event-free work environmentCERTIFICATES & LICENSES-       Valid driver’s license, current vehicle registration and a driving record that is acceptable to the company. Minimum vehicle insurance coverage and ability to maintain vehicle in good repair.-       Successfully complete a MVR and Background check Government Regulations and Safety: We are committed to providing a workplace free from serious recognized hazards and comply with standards, rules and regulations issued under the OSH Act. experience a plus)Deep experience with tagging tools and partners (GTM, Tealium etc.)Demonstrated performance across corporate and franchise business models a plusAbility to evaluate and implement responsive solutions to meet business needsEffective communicator, able to turn complicated data sets into inspiring insights within both small and large group settingsTrack record of building of
